No. 1961/11 – WEDNESDAY APRIL, 06, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

I, hereby give notice under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following Land/Servitude* which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired:

Allotment of Land called Kent Watta in extent of about 8.3120 Hectares, shown as a Lot No. 127 in the F.V.P 60 Sheet No. 6 Supplement No. 7, Prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village of Galahitiyawa of Minor Division of Udugoda Udasiya Pattuwa at Divisional Secretary’s Division of Pallepola of Matale District of Central Province and bounded as follows.

SCHEDULE Lot No. 127 North: Maningamuwa F.V.P. 48, Lot No. 6 and Monaruwila F.V.P. 49; East: Monaruwila F.V.P. 48; South: Lot No. 105 and 39; West: Lot No. 105, 39, 126, 125, 124, 123, 122, 121, 120, 119, 118 and 117.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Pallepola Divisional Secretariat on the 08th day of June, 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th day of May, 2016 the nature of their
interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
W. M. ANANDA, Divisional Secretary, Pallepola Division.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Pallepola, 17th March, 2016.
